title: MCX Trading Time: Commodity Trading Timings in India (2026)
summary: MCX trading time for 2026: non-agri commodities trade 9 AM to 11:30 PM, moving to 11:55 PM from Nov 2. See crude oil, gold and agri timings.
body_markdown:
MCX trading time is the window when you can buy and sell commodity futures and options on the Multi Commodity Exchange of India (MCX). Unlike the stock market, MCX stays open late into the night.


The exact hours depend on two things: the type of commodity you trade, and the time of year.


**Quick answer (October 2026):**


-


Non-agri commodities like crude oil, gold, silver and natural gas trade from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM, Monday to Friday.


-


From November 2, 2026, the closing time for these commodities moves to 11:55 PM.


-


Cotton, cotton oil and kapas trade from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.


-


All other agri commodities trade from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.


Take a look at each timing, why the closing time changes twice a year, and which hours are usually the most active.

Market trading happens from Monday to Friday. MCX stays closed on Saturdays, Sundays and declared trading holidays.


### Morning and Evening Sessions


MCX splits its day into two sessions:


-


The morning session runs from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.


-


The evening session runs from 5:00 PM to the closing time, which is 11:30 PM now and 11:55 PM from November 2, 2026.


This split matters on holidays. On many holidays, MCX closes the morning session but keeps the evening session open.


### Intraday Square-Off Time


If you trade intraday, your broker will close your open positions before the market closes. Many brokers do this about 10 minutes before the close.


That means non-agri intraday positions are usually squared off around 11:20 PM now, and around 11:45 PM from November 2, 2026. Check your broker's exact cut-off time.


### NSE Commodity Timings


NSE also has a commodity derivatives segment. Its commodity trading hours follow the same schedule, and both exchanges revise their hours on the same dates.


## Why MCX Closing Time Changes Twice a Year


The MCX closing time changes because of daylight saving time (DST) in the United States. India does not follow DST, but the US does.


Prices of gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas are strongly linked to US markets. When US clocks move, MCX moves its closing time so Indian traders keep the same overlap with US trading hours.


This is how it works:


-


US daylight saving runs from the second Sunday of March to the first Sunday of November.


-


During this period, MCX closes non-agri commodities at 11:30 PM.


-


For the rest of the year, MCX closes non-agri commodities at 11:55 PM.

Only non-agri commodities are affected. The closing times for cotton, cotton oil, kapas and other agri commodities stay the same all year.


MCX announces each change through a circular a few weeks in advance. It is a good habit to check for this circular every February and September.

### Crude Oil Trading Time in India


Crude oil trades on MCX from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM until October 30, 2026. From November 2, 2026, the crude oil closing time moves to 11:55 PM.


Crude oil usually sees its biggest price moves in the evening. This is when US oil markets are open and US oil data comes out.


### Gold Trading Time in India


Gold trades on MCX from 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM, moving to 11:55 PM from November 2, 2026. Silver follows the same hours.


Gold prices react strongly to US economic data and the US dollar, so the evening hours tend to see bigger moves.


### Natural Gas Trading Time


Natural gas follows the same schedule as crude oil: 9:00 AM to 11:30 PM now, and 9:00 AM to 11:55 PM from November 2, 2026.


### Agri Commodity Timings


Cotton, cotton oil and kapas trade until 9:00 PM because their prices are linked to global markets. Other agri commodities close at 5:00 PM because their prices depend mostly on Indian supply and demand.


## Is MCX Open Today?


MCX is open Monday to Friday, except on declared trading holidays. It is closed on Saturdays and Sundays, apart from special sessions like Muhurat trading.


Because MCX has two sessions, a holiday can close one session or both:


-


On a full-day holiday, both the morning and evening sessions are closed.


-


On a partial holiday, the morning session is closed and the evening session opens at 5:00 PM.


-


On rare days like New Year’s Day, the morning session is open but the evening session is closed.


Most MCX holidays are partial holidays, because global commodity markets keep trading during Indian festivals. For every date and its session status, see our[MCX holidays 2026](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-holidays/) list.


The remaining holidays in 2026 are Diwali Balipratipada (November 10) and Guru Nanak Jayanti (November 24), when trading opens at 5:00 PM, and Christmas (December 25), when MCX is closed all day. MCX also holds[Muhurat trading](https://algotest.in/blog/diwali-muhurat-trading-stock-market/) on Sunday, November 8, 2026, from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM.


## How to Check If MCX Is Open Today


1.


Check the day of the week. MCX does not trade on Saturdays or Sundays.


2.


Check today's date against the MCX holiday list.


3.


If today is a partial holiday, wait for the evening session to open at 5:00 PM.


4.


Check whether you are trading a non-agri or agri commodity, since agri contracts may close before the evening session even starts.


## Most Active Hours on MCX


For non-agri commodities, the evening is usually the busiest part of the MCX day. That is when US markets are open and most global price-moving news comes out.


The morning and early afternoon tend to be calmer for crude oil, gold and silver, since US markets are still closed.

### What This Means for Your Trading


-


Price moves and volume usually pick up after 6:00 PM, so stop losses can get hit faster during this time.


-


Spreads can widen for a few seconds right after major US data releases.


-


The last few minutes before the intraday square-off can be rushed, so plan your exits early.


-


Agri commodities that close at 5:00 PM do not trade during these evening hours at all.
